title: Tidepool Upload Duplication
symptom: When uploading CGM data from xDrip+ to Tidepool and also uploading from a pump (e.g., t:slim x2, Medtronic 723, Omnipod PDM), data such as carbs and boluses gets duplicated, leading to overreported daily insulin doses.
cause: The duplication is caused by two apps uploading the same data (xDrip and the pump uploader).
fix: The issue was fixed by adding an option to select to upload only BG when uploading pump treatments manually.
evidence_quote: It's been fixed. This is a duplicate. You can now select to upload only BG if you upload pump treatments manually.
